summary: Steep, narrow kerb with no stopping signs and houses 2-3 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Houses sit at the kerb edge along the west side, from about 75 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow winding road with a single lane each way and no pull-in.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb.

sun_shade: Heavy tree shade over most of the stretch.
